kept.name: TestAttachGated_Pending
kept.reason: pins a pending gate over a resumed run: the replayed Done evaluates once and sends the carried text, and a bare pending re-evaluates on the throttled cadence rather than every poll tick

kept.name: TestAttach_GateThreading
kept.reason: pins that AttachGated and AttachIfLiveGated gate a resumed run exactly as a fresh one is gated and starts its gate spans afresh, that plain Attach leaves Result.Gate nil, and that the recorded fork authorization, not the attaching spec, chooses the gate closure and the fork audit

kept.name: TestAttach_KeepPane
kept.reason: pins that Spec.KeepPane suppresses an attached run's done cleanup (run dir kept, no RemoveStrand) and that its absence performs both

kept.name: TestAttach_OffsetStartsAtZero
kept.reason: pins that the whole pre-existing events backlog is replayed on attach and its last event wins, for a completion and for a held Stop

kept.name: TestAttach_OutcomeDisposition
kept.reason: pins which persisted Outcome values attach and which are respawn-eligible, with a row each for every terminal, omitted and unrecognized value

kept.name: TestAttach_StartedSeededTrue
kept.reason: pins that a persisted Started: true skips the startup probe on attach, with no engine Startup call and no trust-dismiss Enter played into a live pane

kept.name: TestAttach_StrandLaterLosesPaneBinding
kept.reason: pins that an attached run keeps liveness coverage after a cleared binding: done with files present, and errStrandPaneBindingCleared once an empty Anchor is defaulted to own-window

kept.name: TestAttach_UntrackedTerminalRecord_RespawnEligibleRegardlessOfAge
kept.reason: pins that a terminal persisted Outcome is respawn-eligible at any directory age for both an untracked strand and a cleared pane binding, which the age-rule rows never reach

kept.name: TestCompletionSignal_FileContractCallSites
kept.reason: scans the allOutputFilesExist call sites, catching a guard deleted from an exit that already has one, which the return-site scan cannot see

kept.name: TestCompletionSignal_NegativeVerdictReturnSites
kept.reason: scans wait.go and attach.go for the negative-verdict return sites, catching an unguarded new exit, which no other test reads

kept.name: TestDispositionCandidate_AskingReentry
kept.reason: pins the unit-level verdicts for a legacy asking record, with and without a recorded offset, and the unchanged verdicts for a dead pane and an untracked strand, which the end-to-end attach test never reaches

kept.name: TestGateList_FailPassFailStartsBudgetAfresh
kept.reason: pins the consecutive-failure reset: an entry that fails, passes and fails again gets its whole budget back, with and without pass_on_cap

kept.name: TestGateList_FinalArrivalAtFailingPassOnCapEntry
kept.reason: pins both final arrivals that cannot re-prompt, a failed send and an expired deadline, ending at a failing pass_on_cap entry with the later required entry reported not reached

kept.name: TestGatePending_HoldsSendsOnceAndPasses
kept.reason: pins that a pending gate sends its carried text exactly once, charges no attempt, settles done, and records one gate span then one held span for the held entry and a single gate span for an entry listed before it

kept.name: TestGatePending_MidTurnTicksNeverReevaluate_DeadlineUsesFinal
kept.reason: pins that mid-turn ticks never re-evaluate the gate, that a deadline finalize reads Final rather than Gate and leaves the entry waiting, and that the entry's spans are one gate span then a held span ending at the run's end, with no gate span for the Final evaluation

kept.name: TestGatePending_RejectAfterPendingRepromptsOnce
kept.reason: pins that a rejection after a pending hold re-prompts exactly once with the findings and counts one attempt

kept.name: TestGatePending_VerdictBetweenTicksIsNotMasked
kept.reason: pins that a verdict recorded between idle ticks is read at the first throttled recheck and not masked by the pending state

kept.name: TestGateTerminal_NonTerminalFailureBelowBudgetStillReprompts
kept.reason: pins that a non-terminal failure of a MayHold entry below its budget still re-prompts once and leaves Reason empty, the contrast to a terminal failure

kept.name: TestGate_DeadlineExpiresBetweenAttempts
kept.reason: pins that a deadline expiring or a session lost after one re-prompt runs the gate once more through its own Done, with Attempts still honest at one and the rework span closed at the run's end

kept.name: TestGate_EvaluateOncePerAttempt_Memoized
kept.reason: pins that evaluateGate memoizes within an attempt, returning the same pointer without re-running the closure

kept.name: TestGate_FailsOnceThenPassesOnNextTurn
kept.reason: pins that the re-prompt is a single line naming the findings file, that an entry's own renderer replaces the default line, and that the findings file holds the failed attempt's findings

kept.name: TestGate_FirstDoneSettlesWithoutReprompt
kept.reason: pins that a gate passing on the first Done sends nothing and charges no attempt, that it reports one gate span the closure's length without writing it through the memoised verdict, that a zero GateSpec leaves Result.Gate nil, and that both clean the run dir

kept.name: TestGate_NoLiveSessionDonePaths
kept.reason: pins that every exit with no live session finalizes through its own branch with the gate run once, a failed verdict, and no re-prompt or attempt charged

kept.name: TestGate_SendFailsMidLoop_EndsLoopWithAttemptsSoFar
kept.reason: pins that a failed re-prompt send ends the loop without a retry and charges no attempt or rework span, and that an invalid rendered line sends nothing

kept.name: TestLoadConfig_TemplateDefaultsResolve
kept.reason: pins every shipped template default, which the BackgroundShellWaitMin table does not assert

kept.name: TestModelChoiceMappingRule
kept.reason: scans every production file for a modelspec.Resolved field read outside the mapping, which no other test reads

kept.name: TestPollEventsTick_GatedWaitingWithOutputFilesIsNotAnArrival
kept.reason: pins that a gated waiting turn end is not an arrival: the gate is not evaluated on it and runs exactly once on the next Stop

kept.name: TestPollEventsTick_OutstandingBackgroundWork
kept.reason: pins that a fork or an awaited shell never expires at a waiting turn end, that a non-awaited shell alone expires the ungated wait at the bound, and that a gated run is not done while a non-awaited shell is inside the bound

kept.name: TestPollEventsTick_TurnStartEndsTheGatedShellWait
kept.reason: pins that a turn start past a gated shell wait clears it before the bound can count the run done

kept.name: TestPollEventsTick_Waiting
kept.reason: pins that a waiting turn end is still running and advances the offset, and becomes a held turn end on a later Stop

kept.name: TestPollInterval_FloorsNonPositive
kept.reason: pins the busy-spin guard: a poll_interval_ms below one second is floored to one second, which no Wait test measures

kept.name: TestProviderSeamImportRule
kept.reason: scans every production file's imports for a concrete engine package outside its own directory and the registry, and its calls for AcceptStartupGate outside this package, which no other test reads

kept.name: TestRunState_RoundTrip
kept.reason: pins that every RunState field survives save and load, and that an absent run.json reads as not found rather than as an error

kept.name: TestRun_Finalize_ReportsUsageAndTimes
kept.reason: pins finalize's UsageReader wiring at every terminal outcome, which the Classification table covering its blocks does not assert

kept.name: TestRun_Wait_Classification
kept.reason: pins the outcome, hold log and cleanup of every pane, events and file state Wait classifies, of which the held-run test reaches only a few

kept.name: TestRun_Wait_EventsHandling
kept.reason: pins the offset rules over the events file: the last of several Stops wins, a failed parse's bytes are re-read, and a partial line stays unconsumed

kept.name: TestRun_Wait_Finalize_PersistsOutcomeForEveryTerminalOutcome
kept.reason: pins that finalize persists the matching Outcome in run.json for every terminal outcome, and does so before the done cleanup

kept.name: TestRun_Wait_RunDeadline_SatisfiedFileContractWinsOverTimeout
kept.reason: pins that a satisfied file contract outranks the run deadline for a started run, with no startup probe run

kept.name: TestRun_Wait_StartedRun_SkipsStartupProbe
kept.reason: pins that Wait over a started handle never re-runs the startup probe, with no new engine Startup call and no new capture

kept.name: TestRun_Wait_StartupWindow
kept.reason: pins that the startup window, not the run deadline, classifies every not-ready path, and that a satisfied file contract outranks the expired window

kept.name: TestRunnerStart_NoResumeSessionID_NeverCallsCheck
kept.reason: pins that a spec with no ResumeSessionID never calls the resume check and carries no resume warning

kept.name: TestRunnerStart_Resume_ChecksSessionAgainstPaneCwdBeforePrepare
kept.reason: pins that the resume check runs against the runner's pane cwd and before Prepare, which the warning test does not observe

kept.name: TestRunner_Start_HappyPath
kept.reason: pins Start's exact AddSpec wiring, its single ready probe, the persisted Started, running Outcome and fork authorization, and RunDir naming the created directory

kept.name: TestScanPaneForNeedle
kept.reason: pins the pane scan's count and lines-below at the unit level, including a needle straddling a wrap boundary, which the delivery table reaches only through Send

kept.name: TestShuttleengine_LiveSubstrateLoggingGoesThroughLogger
kept.reason: scans this package's production sources for bare log and fmt.Println calls, which no behavioral test can pin

kept.name: TestStartup_CaptureAlwaysErroringUntilWindowExpires
kept.reason: pins the not-ready teardown's message and the absent startup capture file when every capture fails

kept.name: TestStartup_FailedStartThenAttach_RespawnEligible
kept.reason: pins the seam between a not-ready teardown and Attach: the died run.json left behind is respawn-eligible, not attachable, at any directory age

kept.name: TestStartup_GateNeverClearsUntilWindowExpires
kept.reason: pins a gate that never clears: its dismissals' virtual times, at most one play per dismissal gap, until the window expires

kept.name: TestStartup_NoSkillsNoPromptLineSendsNothing
kept.reason: pins that a launch with no skills and no deferred prompt line types nothing, which the skill-load table never reaches

kept.name: TestStartup_ReadyProbeTiming
kept.reason: pins the ready path's virtual-clock timing: no sleep when ready on the first probe, the base interval while the pane redraws, and the backoff to the dismissal gap while it does not

kept.name: TestStartup_TrustPromptThenReady
kept.reason: pins trust-gate dismissal through the real Start flow: the Enter key, the capture handed to the engine, the persisted Started and running Outcome, and the logged dismissal

kept.name: TestSweepOrphans_AgeGuardAndLiveGuid
kept.reason: pins the age guard over orphans, a live strand guid keeping its dir, and a dir with no run.json being removed only when old

kept.name: TestWait_RecordsEndedShells
kept.reason: pins the ended-shell record and its Info line on the ungated, deadline and liveness ends
